task: Build W2-55 (DAEO-arrl): register tags checked (domain, scope, lands in, status), supersession propagation check, superseded and done entries left out of `gov context`/`gov retrieve` with counts, `gov context --in-force`, and the backfill proposal.
status: PACKAGES — the work is built and committed, and 75 of the 76 acceptance tests pass; the one that fails seems to contradict S3 (package 1).
work_completed: New `gov.decisions.register` reads the register at `HEAD` as the store does (entries, tags, Values, Kept, superseded and changed relations), and holds the in-force digest and the `leave_out` filter. New `gov.decisions.tags` gives `check_tags` and `python3 -m gov.decisions.tags` with the seven S2 codes; `gov.decisions.check` is unchanged. New `gov.decisions.propagation` gives `check_propagation` and `python3 -m gov.decisions.propagation`: `ENFORCES_SUPERSEDED`, found by id and by value, in the S3 places, open tickets only, Kept reasons honoured. `gov retrieve` and the context's supplementary part drop register evidence of superseded or done entries and add `left_out` only when something was dropped, so the packet and its hash stay as before otherwise. `gov context --in-force` gives `lines`, `left_out` and `register`. The parser refuses neither form and refuses both together (checked: exit 2). New `gov.decisions.backfill` writes `docs/research/W2-55-backfill.md` with 979 rows, 121 Amends/Refines relations and a 40-entry sample drawn with seed 55. It is labelled heuristic and nothing is written to the register.

Sandbox check: (a) refused with `OSError: [Errno 30] Read-only file system`; (b) `hash-object` wrote `1ae28402a109`, and `update-index --refresh` exited 0. GOV_ROLE=engineer, GOV_TICKET=DAEO-arrl, toplevel `/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-55`, branch `w2/W2-55`. **KPI 5 on this repository:** `gov.decisions.propagation` exits 1 with 4 findings, all for DEC-876 superseded by DEC-880. They are `tests/acceptance/W2-07/README.md:170`, `test_w2_07_decision_records.py:129`, and `w2_07_support.py:72` and `:80`. All four are citations, which use DEC-876's status line as a sample of the `SUPERSEDED by` form, not enforcement of its rule; they are candidates for `Kept:`. No value findings yet, because the register records no `Values:` lines. **Register check here:** `gov.decisions.tags` exits 1 with 996 findings: 979 TAG_MISSING (every entry, as expected) and 17 STATUS_RELATION_UNMARKED (e.g. DEC-974 changes DEC-220, DEC-961 supersedes DEC-960, DEC-952 changes DEC-880, and DEC-941 changes DEC-831, DEC-847, DEC-936 and DEC-938). `--in-force` on this repository gives 971 lines; left out are 8 superseded entries (DEC-038, 048, 049, 636, 869, 875, 876, 960) and 0 done.
tests: Builder tests: tests/unit/decisions 39 passed. Unit tests context+decisions+cli+close: 571 passed (after the fix in 2281b081; before it, 5 context unit tests failed, see risks). W2-55 acceptance: 75 passed, 1 failed (`test_a_changed_entrys_id_alone_in_the_sweep_is_no_finding`). On the base it was 69 failed, 7 passed. Related acceptance W1-24, W1-41, W1-11, W2-03, W2-87, W1-21 and W2-55 together: 677 passed, 36 failed, 4 errors. Of those, 34 W1-41 failures: the 16 I checked (1 in `test_w1_41_unknown`, 15 in `path_map`, `migration` and one `verdict`) all fail with `ADOPT_CODE_GRAPH_UNREADABLE: Read-only file system: '/tmp/gov-cbm-1000/…'`, a sandbox limit. The other 18 verdict cases were not looked at one by one. The 1 W1-21 family-check failure and the 4 dev-tier errors come with the sandbox refusing outbound connections to ollama.com:443. The last one is the W2-55 case above. None of these touches the changed code.
discoveries: (1) The register's convention (DEC-825 item 4) is that a `**Supersedes:**` naming a part is a "Changed by" relation. I read a Supersedes field as superseding only when it names ids alone (the store's rule); otherwise it is a change. (2) 17 relations recorded on the new entries are not marked on the old ones (listed above). (3) Some old entries name the changing entry in their status words only (e.g. "changed by DEC-938") and not in a `**Changed by:**` field; I accept an id named in the status segment. (4) Some `- **Changes:**` lines stand outside the status line (e.g. register lines 9799, 9873, 10003); S1 reads only status lines, so they are not read. (5) The status word DONE (5 entries) is not "done" under S1, which takes done only from the tags; the backfill proposes `done` for them.
risks: (1) The filter in `leave_out` returns evidence unchanged when no item carries `start_line`. This keeps the stubbed W2-54 unit tests passing (fake root, items without lines); real bundles always carry lines. (2) An expanded parent chunk that touches a left-out entry falls back to its own chunk, and is left out when that chunk touches one too. (3) The backfill's domain, scope and lands-in values are keyword and citation heuristics. 828 of 979 entries come out `repository`, and in-force entries that no file cites get a proposed home: a place to write the rule, not one that states it. The owner's sample is the control. (4) The code is about four times the estimate.
lessons: The Write tool refuses `.gov-runtime/scratch/eng/`; the session scratchpad works. A combined acceptance run of about 50 minutes needs a background run with its output written to a file, not piped through `tail`: the first such run was stopped at its time limit with nothing saved. Inside the sandbox the code graph (`/tmp/gov-cbm-*`) and ollama.com cannot be reached, so the W1-41 and W1-21 dev-tier suites go red there for reasons that have nothing to do with the code.
proposed_decisions: Package 1 (P3; my recommendation: the test designer reviews the test against S3; confidence medium). The test `test_a_changed_entrys_id_alone_in_the_sweep_is_no_finding` fails on finding `[DEC-665, DEC-838]` at `tests/acceptance/W1-49/test_w1_49_live_session.py:5` of its fixture, message "holds '300000'". That is a recorded-value hit on a changed entry, which S3 counts as a finding; it is not an id-alone hit. Either the fixture records "300000" on DEC-665 when it meant only DEC-636, or line 5 holds the value unintentionally. I did not read the test source or the fixture, and I did not change the code to fit the test. Package 2 (P3; recommend the orchestrator; confidence high): when the backfill is applied, add `Kept:` lines for the four W2-07 DEC-876 citations, mark the 17 unmarked relations, and add `Values:` lines to DEC-636, DEC-665, DEC-605 and the like so that propagation searches by value on the real register.
unresolved: KPI 6 (W2-61's measure run again after the merge) belongs to the lead or orchestrator after the merge. KPI 7's session-start hook loading is out of this run (DEC-952 item 5). The backfill is not applied; that waits for the owner's acceptance.
recommended_next_action: Send package 1 to the test designer, then run `gov.decisions.tags`/`propagation` again after the orchestrator applies the accepted backfill.
